svg.title: Held-out networks have different alarms
svg.desc: An illustrative r=1.6, d=0.075, T=4.5, threshold=0.55 slice selected after inspecting the frozen benchmark. This is explanatory selection, not a new held-out experiment or threshold tuning. Points are empirical mean peaks and whiskers are the observed range of eight networks, not confidence intervals. Lower-panel counts pool three families, 24 networks per size. Within each size the full spectra agree; eigenvalues alone leave all finite-horizon alarms undetermined.
